battle.name: 劉迦論起義
battle.theater: 陝北上郡（綏德、延安、安定一帶）
battle.brief: 大業十年（614）五月，劉迦論在陝北聚眾起事，自稱「皇王」，改元「大世」，聯絡稽胡，響應者號稱十萬，波及延安、安定二郡。隋煬帝詔命北方邊軍主將屈突通率軍討伐。屈突通以邊軍精銳馳援，於上郡一帶的黃土溝壑與河谷攻破叛眾，弩兵封鎖谷口與渡口，起義軍潰散，首領被擒。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 起義一方並非獨立國家，而是隋朝邊州民眾與北方稽胡部族臨時結成的武裝聯盟。領袖劉迦論自稱「皇王」，以「大世」為年號，名義上仍是隋朝編號之內的叛亂政權，沒有另立國號與制度。響應者主要來自陝北延安、隴右安定（今甘肅涇陽）一帶的漢人丁壯、逃戶與被徵發未返的民夫，也有沿邊的稽胡騎眾加入，據地多在無定河與綏德川的山谷、堡寨之間。鎮壓一方是隋朝中央軍：隋煬帝楊廣詔令北邊主將屈突通率北方邊軍出戰，官軍以屯田兵、長城戍卒與禁軍精銳為骨幹，歸尚書省調度，戰時由屈突通節制。與此同時，河北的竇建德勢力正在成形，關內亦有其他起義零星發生，隋朝兵力並不能全力投放一處。這場衝突因此是中央與邊州民間武裝之間、又在北方部族問題交錯之中展開的內戰。叛軍的編制、旗號與首領名單，諸史記載有限，諸說並存。
countriesEn: The rebel side was not a state in its own right but an armed coalition patched together between the border populations of Sui China and the Jihu tribes of the northern frontier. Its leader Liu Jialun proclaimed himself 'Emperor and King' and took the era name Dashi, yet he set up no separate state title and built no new institutions: to the court at Luoyang this remained a rebellion inside the empire's own administrative order, not a lawful regime. The responders were mostly Han strongmen, deserters from the household registers and conscripts who never came home, drawn from Yan'an in northern Shaanxi and Anding in Longyou (modern Jingyang, Gansu), together with Jihu horsemen from along the frontier. The side that crushed them was the central army of Sui. Emperor Yang of Sui ordered Qutu Tong, commander of the northern border, to take the field; the government force rested on frontier colonising troops, Great Wall garrison soldiers and picked units of the imperial guards, mustered by the Department of State Affairs and, once deployed, commanded by Qutu Tong himself. At the same time Dou Jiande's power was taking shape in Hebei and other risings flickered inside the passes, so Sui could never commit its full strength to one front. The conflict was thus a civil war between the centre and an armed border society, tangled together with the question of the northern tribes. The organisation, the banners and the list of rebel leaders are poorly recorded, and the sources differ.
people: 劉迦論是這場起義唯一可以確認姓名的核心人物。《隋書》與《北史》記他為延安縣（今陝西延安）人，《舊唐書》與《新唐書》則記為安定縣（今甘肅涇陽）人，籍貫兩說並存，年齡亦無從考定。他在大業十年五月聚眾，自稱「皇王」，改元「大世」，聯絡稽胡，聲勢最盛時響應者號稱十萬。率官軍平叛的是屈突通，朔方人，出身北方部族，隋文帝時已在邊軍效力，開皇年間與宇文忻、蘇威等一同主持長城防務與邊地屯田，隋煬帝即位後拜驃騎將軍，成為鎮守北邊的核心將領之一；他用兵不以多取勝，而靠北方邊軍的騎兵機動與精準打擊。隋煬帝楊廣是最高決策者，起義爆發時他西巡歸來未及數月，朝廷的反應速度直接決定叛眾能否在邊州站住腳跟。起義軍內部的首領名單、地方郡縣官吏的處置，以及劉迦論與同期在河北起兵的劉黑闐是否同族，諸史或略而不載，或說法不一，無法一一坐實。
peopleEn: Liu Jialun is the only core figure of this rising whose name can be confirmed. The History of Sui and the History of the Northern Dynasties make him a native of Yan'an County (modern Yan'an, Shaanxi), while the Old and New Histories of Tang make him a native of Anding County (modern Jingyang, Gansu); the two accounts stand side by side, and his age cannot be established. In the fifth month of the tenth year of Daye he gathered a crowd, proclaimed himself 'Emperor and King', changed the era to Dashi and reached out to the Jihu, and at the height of the rising the response was reckoned at a hundred thousand. The man who led the suppression was Qutu Tong, a native of Shuofang from one of the northern clans, already serving in the frontier army under Emperor Wen; in the Kaihuang era he shared with Yuwen Xin and Su Wei the charge of the Great Wall defences and of the military colonies on the border, and under Emperor Yang of Sui he was made General of the Agile Cavalry, one of the core commanders holding the northern line. He won not by numbers but by the mobility of the northern cavalry and by precision. Emperor Yang himself was the highest decision maker, and he had been back from his western tour only a few months when the rising broke out, so the speed of the court's response decided whether the rebels could hold ground in the border prefectures. The names of the rebel chiefs, the fate of the local prefects and county magistrates, and whether Liu Jialun was of the same clan as Liu Heitao, who rose in Hebei at the same time, are either passed over in silence or given in conflicting ways by the histories, and cannot be settled one by one.
kits: 本卡兵器是弩，即中國式的弩機弓。弩的關鍵在於把弦的拉力預先儲存在弩機之中，射手不必像拉弓那樣每次都張弦、拉滿才能射，因此可以在遠處先張弦待發，進而在短時間內連續擊發；守城一方憑此把攻城者壓在牆外。在隋軍體系中，弩是步卒的骨幹火力：關內與邊軍的步兵以弩為主，執盾、持長槊者居前掩護，弩手居後輪替發射，騎兵則攜帶較小的蹶張弩於近距離射擊；守城時改用張力更大的弩具與機弩，置於城垛，瞄準遠處的接近隊列。起義軍在山地堡寨同樣倚賴弩：把弩分置於隘口與山梁，專射官軍先鋒與傳令騎手，使官軍的攻勢難以展開。官軍的進攻編制中，弩兵除隨隊射擊外，還要封鎖谷口、渡口與退路，把起義眾分割在各條溝壑之間。與弩配合的還有角弓、長槊、環首刀、盾牌，以及雲梯、撞車一類攻城器械；糧秣靠屯田收穫與沿黃河、無定河河谷的車隊輸送。關於本作戰各型弩的具體數目與配發，諸史未載，諸說並存。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the crossbow, the Chinese lock-operated bow. The point of the crossbow is that the tension of the string is stored ahead of time in the lock: the shooter need not draw and hold the string at full stretch on every shot, and can therefore cock the weapon in cover and fire several shots in quick succession. A defending force uses it to pin attackers outside the walls. Within the Sui army the crossbow was the backbone of infantry firepower. Infantry of the interior provinces and of the frontier carried it as their principal arm, with shield-bearers and long-spear men in front for cover and the crossbowmen behind them shooting in relays; cavalry carried smaller foot-tense crossbows for close work, while for the defence of walls the heavier crossbows and the mounted trigger bows were set on the battlements to aim at columns approaching from a distance. The rebels relied on the crossbow just as much from their hill stockades, stationing them at passes and on ridge lines to shoot at the vanguard and at dispatch riders, so that the government attack could hardly get under way. In the assault order of the government army, crossbowmen did more than shoot in support of the advance: they had to seal the mouths of valleys, the fords and the lines of retreat, cutting the insurgents into separate bands in each of the gullies. Working with the crossbow were the composite bow, the long spear, the ring-pommel sabre, the shield, and such siege engines as the scaling ladder and the battering ram; food and fodder came from the military colonies and from wagon trains along the Yellow River and the Wuding valley. The numbers and the issue of each type of crossbow in this particular action are not recorded, and the accounts differ.
tactics: 起義軍的戰術以避實擊虛為主。劉迦論眾多而訓練不齊，又缺乏攻城器械與遠程投射能力，若在開闊地上與隋朝邊軍的騎兵硬拼，極易被分割，所以起義方刻意佔據黃土溝壑、丘陵與河谷的有利地形，以堡寨為核心，時聚時散，避開官軍主力。作戰時多以小股騎隊與步兵配合，倚險伏擊，遠離大道，官軍一至即退往山地，倚賴熟悉地形的本地嚮導。聯絡稽胡一事，說明起義方在騎兵與游擊戰上確有指望，也讓官軍必須同時警戒北方部族的動向。屈突通所部的打法與之相反：北方邊軍歷年與突厥、吐谷渾周旋，習慣以騎兵巡邏警戒、以少量精兵直搗要害，一旦發現叛軍主力所在，便集中出擊，試圖以機動換取決戰的機會；同時封鎖黃河與無定河沿線的渡口與糧道，斷其補給，再以步卒弩陣進逼河谷，令起義眾在缺糧與失去退路的狀況下潰散。官軍追擊之時多遣輕騎晝夜兼程，窮追不捨。史書未載此次交戰的具體陣形與旗號，上述推想多據同時代西北邊防的一般情形，諸說並存。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents rested on avoiding the enemy's strength and striking where he was weak. Liu Jialun had many men but little training, and no siege engines or long-range artillery; in open country a set battle against the Sui frontier cavalry would have destroyed him. So the rebel side deliberately held the ravines, the loess hills and the river valleys, made its stockades the core of its position, gathered and dispersed by turns, and kept off the great roads. In action it worked with small bodies of horsemen and foot, ambushed from cover, and withdrew into the hills the moment government troops appeared, relying on local guides who knew the country. The alliance with the Jihu shows that the insurgents counted on cavalry and on a war of harassment, and it also forced the government to watch the northern tribes while it fought. Qutu Tong's approach was the opposite. Frontier troops schooled for years against the Turks, the Tuyuhun and the other northern peoples were used to patrolling with cavalry and to striking with a small picked force at the decisive point: once the rebel main body was located, they concentrated their blow, trying to turn mobility into a decision. At the same time they sealed the fords and the supply lines along the Yellow and Wuding rivers, cutting the insurgents off from food, and then advanced with infantry and crossbow formations into the valleys, so that the rebels disintegrated for want of supplies and of any way out. The pursuit was carried out by light cavalry riding day and night. The histories do not record the actual formations and banners used in this engagement; much of the above is inferred from the general conditions of north-western frontier warfare in the era, and the accounts differ.
data: 關於這場起義，數字最少，也最需要謹慎。可以確定的是時間：大業十年（614）五月起事，同年被平定，自聚眾到潰敗不足數月，首領被擒獲處置，無力經營。規模方面，《隋書》一系的記載說響應者達十萬之眾，《北史》沿用同一說法；所謂十萬，顯然是起義方自報或朝廷誇大的虛數，實際能集結上陣的兵力應當遠少於此，諸說並存，不能當作確數使用。地理上，起義方活動的延安、安定一帶，距決戰地點上郡（今陝西綏德、榆林一線）不過數百里，黃河與無定河谷是官軍輸送兵員糧秣的通道；官軍自北方邊防線出動，前線距離短，這是它能迅速平叛的關鍵。武器方面可作比較的，是弩與弓的一般機械差異：弩手預先張弦待發，可在數秒內連續擊發數次，拉弓射手則須每次重新張弦，一分鐘內難以超過一兩次。具體傷亡數字、官軍出動兵員、繳獲器械數量，三家正史均無記載，本條一概不臆造。
dataEn: Figures for this rising are the scarcest of all, and they need the most caution. What is certain is the timing: the revolt began in the fifth month of the tenth year of Daye (614) and was crushed in the same year, so from the gathering of men to the dispersal it lasted less than a few months; the leader was taken and put to death, and the rising never had the strength to organise itself. On the scale of the movement, the History of Sui and the History of the Northern Dynasties both speak of a hundred thousand responding; a hundred thousand is plainly the insurgents' own boast or a figure inflated by the court, and the number of men actually mustered and put in the line must have been far smaller. The accounts differ, and it cannot be treated as an exact total. Geographically, the Yan'an and Anding districts where the rising operated lay within several hundred li of the field of decision at Shangjun (around Suide and Yulin in modern Shaanxi); the Yellow River and the Wuding valley were the corridors by which the government moved men and food. The government army set out from the northern frontier line, a short distance away, and that short approach is the key to how quickly the rebellion was put down. On weapons, one comparison can be made on general mechanical grounds: a crossbowman whose weapon is already cocked can fire several shots in a few seconds, while a bowman must re-draw the string for every arrow and can hardly manage more than one or two a minute. Concrete casualty figures, the number of government troops committed and the quantity of captured equipment are given by none of the principal histories, and this account invents none of them.
cause: 大業年間的隋朝已陷入典型的末世循環：兩征高句麗耗空了府庫與丁口，役使、徵發與轉運沒有停止，河北與江南的租調又被地方勢力截斷。劉迦論起事的地區正是這套體制的接合處——陝北與隴右既是邊軍屯田、徵兵、輸糧的前線，又是通往長城與西域的孔道；朝廷在此徵發丁夫、修築城壘、輸送糧秣，年年不輟。邊州地力有限，一旦遇上旱澇，歉收的丁壯與逃戶便聚集成流民。大業十年春，隋煬帝再度西巡隴右，巡行涇州、張掖一線，沿途州縣迎送供應，民間負擔沉重；數月之後，劉迦論便在陝北舉起「皇王」「大世」的旗號，時間上的緊接說明邊民的怨憤並非空泛之談。諸史未明言西巡與起義之間的因果，《隋書》只把起義歸於民變，沒有深入民間原因；此外，隋朝在北方與吐谷渾、突厥的戰事長期消耗邊軍，邊防空隙遂成流民與部族武裝的聚集之地。
causeEn: Sui in the Daye era had fallen into the classic cycle of a dying dynasty. Two campaigns against Goguryeo had emptied the treasury and consumed the registered households, yet the labour levies, the requisitions and the transport convoys were never stopped, while the grain and cloth of Hebei and Jiangnan were being intercepted by regional powers. The country where Liu Jialun rose was exactly where that system joined together: northern Shaanxi and Longyou were both the front line for frontier colonising troops, conscription and grain transport, and the corridor towards the Great Wall and the western regions. The state's capacity in those districts was thin, and once drought or flood spoiled the harvest, the hungry strongmen and the runaways gathered into bands. In the spring of the tenth year of Daye the emperor toured the west once more, passing through Jingzhou and Zhangye, and the prefectures along the route had to meet, feed and escort him; the burden on the countryside was heavy, and a few months later Liu Jialun raised the banner of 'Emperor and King' and the era 'Dashi' in northern Shaanxi. The closeness of the two events suggests that the resentment of the border people was no vague talk. The histories do not state a causal link between the tour and the rising; the History of Sui simply files it among the risings of the people and does not go into popular causes. Alongside this, the long wars of Sui against the Tuyuhun and the Turks in the north wore down the frontier army, and the gaps in the northern defence became the place where displaced villagers and tribal war bands could assemble.
impact: 就當時而言，這場起義是隋末民變中較早被撲滅的一場，維持不過數月，未能形成割據。劉迦論所立的自稱「皇王」與年號「大世」隨之湮滅，《隋書》《北史》《舊唐書》《新唐書》都只留下數行記載，連他與劉黑闐是否同族、族屬到底如何都無法說清。從長遠看，影響反而更為隱性：隋朝把北方邊軍與屯田體系捲入平叛，陝北、隴右的戍守與運輸再無從寬緩，幾年之後北方局勢更壞——劉黑闐在河北起兵、竇建德在河北建國、北方部族乘機南下，最終隋室於大業十八年（618）傾覆，李唐取而代之。可以說，劉迦論這類邊州起義是隋室崩解的早期徵候：它暴露的是一個王朝在財政枯竭與邊防壓力下，已經無法把地方社會重新編排成可以服從的秩序。起義者個人的失敗，並不能證明王朝的問題已經解決。
impactEn: For its own time this rising was one of the earlier revolts of the late Sui to be extinguished: it lasted no more than a few months and never became a separatist state. The title 'Emperor and King' and the era name 'Dashi' vanished with it, and the History of Sui, the History of the Northern Dynasties, the Old and New Histories of Tang leave behind only a few lines apiece, so little that even the question whether Liu Jialun and Liu Heitao were of one clan cannot be settled. In the longer run the effect is more oblique. Sui dragged its northern frontier army and its military colonies into the suppression, and the garrisons and the transport of northern Shaanxi and Longyou could never afterwards be eased; a few years later the northern situation grew worse still, with Liu Heitao rising in Hebei, Dou Jiande founding a state there, the northern clans moving south, and finally the Sui house falling in the eighteenth year of Daye (618) and the Tang replacing it. Revolt of this kind in the border prefectures was an early symptom of the dynasty's coming apart: it showed that a state whose finances were exhausted and whose frontier was overstretched could no longer re-order local society into something obedient. The personal failure of Liu Jialun himself did not mean that the problems of the dynasty had been solved.
result: 大業十年五月，劉迦論在陝北聚眾，自稱「皇王」、年號「大世」，聯絡稽胡，響應者號稱十萬，波及延安、安定等地。隋煬帝詔命北方邊軍主將屈突通率軍討伐。屈突通以邊軍精銳疾馳至陝北，選擇上郡（今陝西綏德一帶）的黃土溝壑與河谷地帶攻擊，進攻中以弩兵掩護步騎、封鎖谷口與渡口，迫使起義眾在缺糧、退路被斷的情況下作戰。起義軍潰散，首領劉迦論為官軍所擒斬，部眾大部潰散歸鄉或散入山澤，其政權僅存數月即告覆亡。這場衝突沒有改變隋朝的疆域，也沒有改變北方的部族格局，但它讓隋朝在最後幾年裡又消耗了一批邊軍主力，也讓北方邊州在接下來的亂局中更加空虛。史書對起義的過程細節記載稀少，能確定的只有起事時間、旗號、規模與被破的地點，其餘諸說並存，不宜妄加補充。
resultEn: In the fifth month of the tenth year of Daye (614) Liu Jialun gathered men in northern Shaanxi, proclaimed himself 'Emperor and King', took the era name 'Dashi', reached out to the Jihu, and was said to have drawn a hundred thousand respondents, spreading through the districts of Yan'an and Anding. Emperor Yang of Sui ordered Qutu Tong, commander of the northern border, to take the field. Qutu Tong marched the picked troops of the frontier army rapidly into northern Shaanxi and attacked in the loess gullies and river valleys around Shangjun (modern Suide in Shaanxi); in the assault the crossbowmen covered the foot and the horse, sealed the mouths of the valleys and the fords, and forced the insurgents to fight with their supplies cut and their road back gone. The rising collapsed; Liu Jialun was taken and killed by the government troops, and most of the rank and file dispersed to their villages or scattered into the hills, so that the regime lasted no more than a few months. This clash changed neither the territory of Sui nor the tribal map of the north, but it consumed another slice of the frontier army in the last years of the dynasty and left the northern border districts still more hollow, and the details of the rising are thinly recorded: only the date of the outbreak, the banner, the scale and the place of defeat are certain, and on everything else the accounts differ and no filling in should be attempted.
